title: Live-prefixed value with a body shorter than the documented length
summary: The same assignment as the positive case, but the body is 24 characters instead of 32.
rationale: A twin that changes exactly one grammar property shows whether length is part of what makes the value a credential.

expectation.rationale: The provider SDK rejects live keys with a body that is not exactly 32 characters, so this cannot be an issued key.
